description: Profiles exercised by the INT-026 PHI-blockout denial-path matrix. Adding a row here is the only change required to extend coverage to a new profile — the Apex tests and the Node API runner both read this list.

deny_profiles.note: Hardest case — View All Data must still be blocked by the Restriction Rule

allow_profiles.note: Positive-path cell — must succeed AND write Audit_Log__c in the same transaction
